title: Nano-to-microscale mechanical characterization of tung oil-calcium alginate capsules for self-healing soils

material_structure.zero_oil: calcium-alginate gel without tung oil; hydrated samples still contain water
material_structure.oil_bearing: dispersed oil chambers in an alginate matrix; dehydrated high-oil specimens show interconnected channels
material_structure.loading_basis_note: The paper describes core loading in mass terms and gives a synthesis example of 20 g oil per 100 g alginate solution. Actual post-hydration oil volume fraction is not supplied.

microcompression.paper_contact_assumption: minimal friction for the initial Hertz interpretation
microcompression.Hertz_modulus_scope: effective whole-particle small-deformation response, not a directly measured homogeneous shell constitutive modulus

nanoindentation.reported_load_unit_typo_requires_caution: Section 2.3 prints approximately 50 micrometres as a maximum load; figure 8 and the workbook use micronewtons. Do not create a loading-rate inference from that sentence.
nanoindentation.modulus_scope: local indentation response; do not substitute for the microscale effective modulus

development_constraints: The existing 1 mm / 20 micrometre shell / 0.1 m/s case is a numerical reference, not an experimental reproduction.
with_liquid=false in the existing hollow-shell example is not a homogeneous zero-oil gel model.
Do not infer physical time from worksheet row number or sort away unloading history.
Do not fit a unique relaxation time or viscosity without the relevant loading history.
Preserve nominal labels and both equal Micro-H curves; do not count duplicates as independent validation.
No existing R8 receipt, executable, numerical guard or archived production queue is changed by this reference profile.
